answer.evidence: The object is a full-width skyline of treetops: a lit, light-green canopy mass at rows 16-34 seen from above, over a darker shaded foliage band at rows 35-47 that acts as the front/shadowed face. The lit crowns show a horizontal leaf surface with a shadowed underside, so it reads as a top surface plus a front face, though it is organic with no hard edge line. A column scan shows brightness dropping from L~150-170 at rows 19-23 to L~26-50 at rows 35+, consistent with a lit top and a shaded front.
